question: In February 2023, which retired Supreme Court Judge was appointed as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Syed Abdul Nazeer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Former SC Judge Justice S Abdul Nazeer** has been appointed as the **new governor of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• President Draupadi Murmu approved the recommendations of the Centre on the transfers and appointments of the new governors.
 
• Justice Abdul Nazeer is on the constitutional bench that delivered the **verdict on the Ayodhya temple issue**.
 
• Justice Nazeer was also on the constitutional bench that delivered the **verdict on the triple talaq controversy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Justice Nazeer is a native of Karnataka and served as Karnataka High Court judge.
 
• Before getting appointed as an additional judge of the Karnataka High Court in 2003, Nazeer practiced in the High Court as an advocate.
 
• Subsequently, he became a permanent judge of the Karnataka High Court.
 
• Justice Nazeer was elevated as Supreme Court judge in 2017.
 
• SC gave the verdict based on the ASI report. Justice Nazeer retired from the SC in Jan 2023.
